name: Task_2
description: Cool the supplied equilibrated sodium silicate state from 1300 K to 300 K. Use the supplied BKS-type Buckingham-Coulomb potential with PPPM electrostatics in LAMMPS, with real units, charge atom style, periodic boundaries, and isotropic NPT at zero target pressure. Cool continuously at 50 K/ps for 20 ps (20,000 steps with a 1 fs timestep). Keep the same atoms and velocities throughout the run. Choose suitable simulation and sampling settings. Save the cooled state, the input and log files, and a time-resolved record of elapsed time, target temperature, measured temperature, pressure, and density.
submission_format: Submit the path to your completed manifest.json file. Use the blank example as a guide and fill in the required fields for this task. Paths inside the manifest may be relative to the manifest file.
